name: GNews API
rate_limits: 100 requests/day; 1 request/second on free tier; resets at 00:00 UTC
notes: Covers 80,000+ sources worldwide. Historical data back to 2020. Free tier is development only — no commercial use. Filter by language, country, category, keywords. Trusted by IBM, Bloomberg, Huawei. Useful for AI because of clean JSON structure, broad multilingual coverage, and keyword search with boolean operators. Exceeding limit returns HTTP 403.
